## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2261458d18b17ff10c39e3e509112cb87f913c25`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0131-total-organization-ownership-no-null-organization-id.md + packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-metadata-activation.object.ts, packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-inventory.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-plugin.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-rule-service.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-rule-provenance.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-platform-setting.object.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-setting.object.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-secret.object.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-setting-audit.object.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/audit/sys-email.object.ts, packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts, packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-activation-store.ts, packages/objectql/src/action-activation.ts, packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/catalog-activation.ts (cited code read on `origin/main` `e22defb1`, which is byte-identical to the merge base `71fa166e` on the ADR)

Rendered by an isolated at-tier reviewer subagent of the adopting seat (`session_01Y5583bs2RDd53MH6kM1ca3`), on these inputs and nothing else: card #24420 (body; claim 6257558991; amendment 6257685312; reports 6257808694 and 6257947772, the second superseding the first), rulings 6257388265 (B′ on #24378) and 6257510973 (Q1–Q4 A on #24377) verbatim, PR #24422's body, file list and comments (none), the net diff `git diff origin/main...2261458d`, the whole ADR at the head, the cited code, and the head's 46 check-runs. The head was re-resolved first and has not moved.

### ① Derived judgments

The diff is one file, +44/−0, a pure insertion of five dated blockquote notes; no existing line is changed, so no ruled sentence is rewritten — the PR's claim holds. Each note copies the record's existing `Note (YYYY-MM-DD, ruling of record …)` form and is dated 2026-10-19, the date of both rulings.

**(a) The D6 note (head :434–:445) against B′ 6257388265 — right, no binding added, dropped or softened.**
- Item 1 (the chart): stated whole — a stored `sys_sharing_rule` row carrying a declared rule's name, in its scope, replaces the declared rule whole; `active: false` on that row is the switch-off; D10's ownership ceremony deletes only uncustomised mirrors. The #2909 promise is carried as content rather than as the ruling's line citation (`sharing-plugin.ts:852`–`:857`); that is right, since the ADR symbol-anchor gate forbids line numbers in ADR text, and the code at those lines on main says exactly that ("the ownership ceremony deletes only uncustomized copies", the `bindRuleProvenanceStamp` hook).
- Item 2 (the guard): "a write that creates a `sys_sharing_rule` row, or renames one, to a declared rule's name in that scope, and is not an edit of the projected row, is refused at the write door with the vendor rule named." The ruling's "through Setup's New (or any write that is not an edit of the projected declared row)" is carried whole by the general clause; the second sentence of item 2 is carried as "The row is made by editing the declared rule's projected row in Setup."
- Item 3 (the reconcile): the ruling's sentence verbatim; `sweepOrphanedRuleGrants()` exists in `sharing-rule-service.ts` and is the boot call in `sharing-plugin.ts`.
- Item 4 (scope): stated with D3 as its ground; the code backs it — the holder key in `sharing-rule-service.ts` is `name` under `single` and `name::organization_id` otherwise.
- Item 5: A and C are stated as exclusions ("⛔ Sharing rules get no activation-ledger type, and same-name rows are not refused as a class"); D ("nothing left as is") is not spelled but is negated by construction — the guard and the reconcile are named as #24421's build. Not a dropped binding.
- Nothing beyond the ruling binds: "(D3)", "D10's" and "(ruling item 4)" are cross-references to text that already says what they cite (D3 :326–:328; D10 fate 2).

**(b) The D7 activation-ledger note (head :515–:524) — within B′ item 1, a reading note, right.**
- B′ item 1 orders this PR to resolve "ADR-0131's own contradiction on the activation ledger (D7 `:491` against D6 `:419`–`:420` and D13 `:699`–`:700`) so the record reads one way"; the card forbids resolving it by rewriting the ruled text. The three citations map onto the merge base exactly: `:491` is the "reverted before 17.3 and does not return" clause (head :504), `:419`–`:420` is unchanged (above the insertions), `:699`–`:700` is "`sys_metadata_activation` is **not** on this list" (head :743–:744).
- The note picks the side the rest of the record already holds: D6 :419–:420 and :492, D13 :743–:744, D14 :751–:752, §1.7 :224–:226, §7 :955–:957 ("card #15024, re-scoped from a revert after the standard-package reversal") and the C0 row :996. Only the D7 clause was the outlier, so no decision was open; the note settles how a stray sentence is read and leaves it in place.
- The code supports the reading it picks: `sys-metadata-activation.object.ts` declares `systemFields: { tenant: false }` on main and at tag `@objectstack/platform-objects@17.3.0` (so "its reserved organization column was dropped before 17.3" is true — #15024 closed `completed` via PR #15155, merged 2026-09-04); the readers the note names exist as named — `FlowActivationStore` (`service-automation/src/engine.ts`, `flow-activation-store.ts`), `objectql/src/action-activation.ts`, `core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts`, `runtime/src/domains/catalog-activation.ts`; the C7 inventory row reads "D7, D6, D14 (C0): the tenant-less activation ledger". "A member of this paragraph's family" matches D7 :503–:504, where the object is already listed inside the `sys_metadata` family.

**(c) The three D7 notes (head :536–:554) against 6257510973 items 2 and 4 — right.**
- Identity-mail list: verify, reset, magic link, email change, an account invitation to a person with no organization — the ruling's five, no more and no fewer.
- Tenant mail stays in `sys_email` with its organization NOT NULL and #11303 decision 2 keeps it stamped at its producers — exactly the content item 2 orders into the dated line, and it matches D7 :529–:530.
- "⛔ Neither a nullable column nor unpersisted mail" carries "Not a nullable column; not 「no persistence」".
- `sys_secret` is column-less; ownership follows the referencing row with the ruling's own list (`sys_setting` / `sys_platform_setting`, the webhook, the flow credential, the field's record, the datasource); every read stays by id under privilege.
- `sys_setting_audit`'s global rung goes to a deployment-level sibling; its tenant and user rows stay NOT NULL.
- Each ends "This is a ruled decision that a C8 stage builds; it has not shipped." That qualifier is load-bearing and present on all three: on main `sys_secret` still carries the injected column (inventory fate `attribution`) and `sys_setting_audit` still holds `scope: 'global'` rows.
- The present-tense claim "the same departure `sys_setting`'s global rung already makes" is TRUE on main: `sys-platform-setting.object.ts` is declared `systemFields: { tenant: false }` with the docblock "the global rung leaves the tenant-scoped table"; `sys-setting.object.ts` says "the deployment-level rung left this tenant-scoped table (ADR-0131 D7)"; the inventory names `sys_platform_setting` as "the settings global rung's tenant-less holder (C6, record 6051723395)".
- Stage-level clauses the notes leave on the ruling record (cited by id) rather than restating: Q2's ceremony sentence and "one more table for plugin-email's by-id and by-status reads"; Q4's `access: { default: 'private' }` stays, `encryptSecretFields` keeps writing, the #24369 premise correction, and the audit-row ceremony. None is what the ruling ordered into the dated line (item 2 names the line's content; item 4 orders "a dated line" and the note carries its decision), and D10 governs ceremonies generally — not dropped bindings. One the maintainer may want spelled: `access: { default: 'private' }`, whose only carrier in the note is "under privilege".

**(d) Internal consistency, anchors and links — consistent; all resolve.**
- D3: the D6 note's "a sharing rule an organization writes stays its row (D3)" is D3 :326–:328 in substance.
- D7's tenant/deployment split: the identity-mail sibling is column-less (deployment-level) while `sys_email` keeps NOT NULL; `sys_secret` column-less under permission is the TL;DR's third shape, "governed by permission, not by a wall"; the `sys_setting_audit` split mirrors `sys_setting`/`sys_platform_setting`. Consistent.
- D9: identity mail is precisely the write D9 refuses under a wall (tenant-column object, no organization); the sibling is the answer, not an exemption. Consistent.
- D10: nothing contradicted; "deletes only uncustomised mirrors" is fate 2.
- D13: the ledger stays off the list (:743–:744) and the D6 note adds no ledger type for sharing rules. Consistent.
- Two tensions the notes record rather than create, both the rulings' own and neither blocking: (i) D6 :425–:426 ("every regime there is environment-wide and operator-gated — a plant admin neither overlays, switches nor clones") now has a ruled carve-out for `sharing_rule` under a wall (B′ item 4, "today's behaviour"); the note states the carve-out and its D3 ground but does not label it an exception to that sentence. (ii) D7 :532–:534 ("this record names only the objects whose verdict the tree already states") now precedes three notes naming objects whose verdict is ruled but not yet in the tree; the "has not shipped" qualifier is the reconciliation. Both are dated notes beside ruled text — the form the card ordered.
- Anchors and links: the notes carry no markdown links; `§7`, `D3`, `D10`, `D13`, `D14`, `C0` resolve inside the record; `#24421` (open, the companion code card), `#15024` (closed completed), `#11303`, `#24378`, `#24377` exist; the one cited file path exists on main and carries no line number. Gate verdicts on the head: `Check ADR cross-links` success (job Check Documentation Links); `ADR anchors + number uniqueness` success (job Lint · repo & tooling gates) and `ADR symbol anchors resolve (no line numbers survive)` success (job Lint · docs & code guards) — both of those steps are `continue-on-error: true` in lint.yml, so their STEP conclusions were read, not the jobs': both `success`.

**Check-runs on 2261458d:** 46, all `completed`; 0 `failure`, 0 `in_progress`. The five required contexts: Lint & Repo Gates success, TypeScript Type Check success, Test Core success (shards 1–6 success), Governed Surface Queue Guard success, Build Core `skipped` (paths filter — docs-only; not a failure, and nothing for a docs diff to build). The four PR-body gates re-ran on the seat's 02:00Z body edit and are success, including "Part-of PR must not also close its card". Check Changeset `skipped` (the `skip-changeset` label honoured).

### ② Semver level

Docs-only edit of a governed ADR; no package path touched; nothing published from any released package. `skip-changeset` is right — the label is for a diff that publishes nothing, and Check Changeset honoured it. `Clause-②: no` is right — no authorable key, export or config field widens or narrows; the text records rulings. Body accuracy against the diff: `+44 / −0` ✓, one file ✓, five notes at the stated places ✓ (after D6's install-mode bullets; after D7's first paragraph; after D7's writer-membership paragraph), lines 1–4 `Fixes #24420` / `Part of #24343` / `Part of #15212` / `Clause-②: no` ✓; the live body equals the seat's `body.new.md` byte-for-byte plus one trailing newline. One imprecision, non-blocking: "Notes 1 and 2 carry out ruling B′ … items 1 and 5" — note 1 also records items 2, 3 and 4, as the body's own bullets then list. The `席位意见` slot in 维护者速读 is still empty — the seat's to fill before it asks for the word.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. **Keep B′ item 4's scope in the D6 note — A, keep.** It is the ruling's own item, grounded in D3 and in today's holder key; dropping it would leave D6's heading ("never per organization") and D3 (an organization's sharing rule is its row) reading two ways for this one type. Flagged for the maintainer: under a wall this is a ruled carve-out from D6 :425–:426, recorded here as the ruling's.
2. **Settle the ledger by a reading note rather than escalate — A, accept.** B′ item 1 ordered this PR to resolve the contradiction; the card forbade rewriting; D6, D13, D14, C0, §1.7, §7 and the shipped code (main and the 17.3.0 tag) already hold one side. No decision was open to escalate.
3. **Three separate dated notes with no stage ids — A, keep.** Each note cites its ruling record by id, the ADR's citation form; stage ids (8b-0d, 8b-0e) belong to the C8 plan on #15212 and would bind plan numbering into governed text. The PR body's "它合并后 8b-0d、8b-0e 才能派发" is the right place for them.
4. **Deviations the reports list.** (i) Edits moved from the cloud checkout to a dedicated worktree after `guard-main-checkout` refused — that is Prime Directive #11 holding; the claim's "Worktree: the cloud session's own checkout" was the deviation and the dev corrected it; nothing owed. (ii) Gates ran on `7b9b0c0` and were pushed as `a41ddd96` with the trailer reworded — tree identity is unverifiable from here; CI on both pushed heads is the verdict and it is green. (iii) `premise_still_valid: true` holds: main is byte-identical to the merge base on the ADR, so the notes land where the rulings' line citations point.
5. This review made no GitHub write, no checkout, no build, no test and no gate re-run; `git fetch` into an owned ref `refs/review/pr-24422` and the record-template print were its only local commands.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-24420-adr-0131-d6-sharing-rule-overlay`
Reviewed-by: `session_01Y5583bs2RDd53MH6kM1ca3`

**VERDICT: PASS**

Maintainer, before merging (Tier H — your approval, your ready-for-review flip and your click; the PR is still a draft): read the five notes at head :434–:445, :515–:524 and :536–:554 — the one thing to weigh is the D6 note's per-organization overlay for `sharing_rule` under a wall (B′ item 4), a ruled carve-out from D6 :425–:426 that the note records but does not label as such.
